name: github_api_fetch
what_it_does: HTTP GET against api.github.com returning parsed JSON with status code and rate-limit headers; uses an optional GITHUB_TOKEN if the user supplies one
output: status code, selected JSON fields, X-RateLimit-Remaining
example_output: {"status":200,"tag_name":"python-v0.7.5","published_at":"2025-09-30T05:48:06Z","ratelimit_remaining":57}. If unfilled: use fetch_url on the same API URLs; if that fails, use web pages and label rows 'web-page fallback, not API'.

name: github_api_fetch
what_it_does: Same GitHub API GET tool, for QA's independent re-fetch (about 13 calls)
output: status code, selected JSON fields, X-RateLimit-Remaining
example_output: {"status":200,"stargazers_count":0,"ratelimit_remaining":40}. If unfilled: use fetch_url; on 403 or failure mark the check UNVERIFIED, not PASS.

name: send_email
for_role: Technical Report Author and Delivery Specialist
what_it_does: Sends an email with attachments through a configured SMTP or email-service account
input: to, subject, body, attachment file paths
output: success flag and message id, or an error
example_output: {"sent":true,"message_id":"<abc123@mail>"}. If unfilled: write an .eml with attachments via Python's email library and report NOT SENT (account and credentials are the user's to supply).

name: xlsx
what_it_does: Instructions and local tools for creating Excel workbooks
example_output: github_agent_frameworks.xlsx. If unfilled: use openpyxl directly in Bash.

name: xlsx
what_it_does: Instructions and local tools for inspecting Excel workbooks (types, hyperlinks, images)
output: cell values and types, image and hyperlink presence
example_output: 5 rows, stars int, dates real, 5 hyperlinks, 1 image. If unfilled: use openpyxl directly in Bash.

name: docx
for_role: Technical Report Author and Delivery Specialist
what_it_does: Instructions and local tools for creating Word documents
example_output: github_agent_frameworks_report.docx. If unfilled: use python-docx directly in Bash.

name: docx
what_it_does: Instructions and local tools for inspecting Word documents (text, tables, images, citations)
output: word count, table and image presence, citation map
example_output: 560 words, 1 table, 1 image, 11 refs all cited. If unfilled: use python-docx directly in Bash.

name: python_interpreter
what_it_does: Runs Python 3 with openpyxl and matplotlib in the sandbox workspace
example_output: stars_chart.png created. If unfilled: use the Bash tool to run python3.

name: python_interpreter
for_role: Technical Report Author and Delivery Specialist
what_it_does: Runs Python 3 with python-docx and the email library in the sandbox workspace
example_output: docx created. If unfilled: use the Bash tool to run python3.

name: python_interpreter
what_it_does: Runs Python 3 with openpyxl and python-docx for read-only inspection of the deliverables
example_output: check results printed. If unfilled: use the Bash tool to run python3.

name: docx_to_pdf_page_count
for_role: Technical Report Author and Delivery Specialist
what_it_does: Converts a .docx to PDF (e.g. LibreOffice headless) and returns the page count
example_output: pages: 2. If unfilled: estimate from word count (~500 words per page) plus image height and label it an estimate.

name: docx_to_pdf_page_count
what_it_does: Same converter, for QA's independent page count
example_output: pages: 2. If unfilled: QA states its count is an ESTIMATE and does not report an independent PASS for page count.
